user.title: Select a nearby SO diffuser
user.description: Select a nearby SO diffuser or enter its Bluetooth address manually.

manual.title: Enter the SO diffuser Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter your SO diffuser's Bluetooth address.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm the SO diffuser
bluetooth_confirm.description: Confirm that this is your diffuser and continue setup.

credentials.title: Diffuser credentials
credentials.description: Sign in with Xiaomi to obtain the device's BLE token, or use an existing saved token.

oauth_error.title: Authorization did not complete
oauth_error.description: Authorization did not complete. Retry Xiaomi sign-in. Previously saved credentials are unchanged.

cloud_device.title: Choose an SO diffuser from Xiaomi
cloud_device.description: Turn on the diffuser. Close Mi Home on your phone and, if necessary, temporarily disable your phone's Bluetooth. Then select your device.

oauth_manual.title: Xiaomi sign-in without local callback
oauth_manual.description: {link_left}Sign in with Xiaomi{link_right}. If homeassistant.local fails to open after login, copy the **entire URL from your browser** and paste it below. Never share this URL.

experimental_confirm.title: Experimental compatibility — {model}
experimental_confirm.description: BLE control for {model} is experimental. Setup verifies the token, but some functions may behave differently. Test them manually before adding automations.

data.acknowledge: I understand this model is experimental and want to try it

error.invalid_address: Enter a six-byte Bluetooth address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX form.
error.token_missing: No saved token found. Choose Sign in with Xiaomi to acquire the token automatically.
error.token_permissions: The token file must be owner-readable without group/world or execute permissions (0600 or stricter).
error.token_type: The token path must be a regular file, not a symlink or directory.
error.token_format: The token file must contain exactly 24 hexadecimal characters with no newline.
error.cloud_request_failed: Could not contact Xiaomi. Check your network and retry.
error.cloud_http_error: Xiaomi rejected the request or is unavailable.
error.cloud_rejected: Xiaomi rejected the authorization or device-list request.
error.invalid_device_list: Xiaomi returned an invalid device list.
error.no_s5_in_account: No recognized SO model with a valid GATT token was found in this Xiaomi account.
error.invalid_cloud_device: The selected device is no longer available.
error.ble_not_available: The diffuser is not visible over Bluetooth. Turn it on and check your Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or active Bluetooth proxy.
error.ble_auth_failed: Could not connect to the diffuser or verify its BLE token. Turn it on, close Mi Home, and temporarily disable Bluetooth on your phone, then retry.
error.credential_storage_failed: The token could not be saved securely. The previous token was retained.
error.invalid_oauth_callback: The redirect URL or authorization state is invalid. Copy the full URL after a fresh Xiaomi login.
error.experimental_confirmation_required: You must explicitly acknowledge experimental compatibility.
error.experimental_cloud_required: This SO model needs Xiaomi account selection and explicit experimental confirmation. The legacy S5 token-file path is not valid for this device.
error.model_mismatch: The Xiaomi Cloud model does not match the discovered Bluetooth model. Select the correct device.
error.legacy_entry_exists: A legacy so_s5 entry already controls this Bluetooth address; duplicate connections are not allowed.
error.ble_connection_failed: Could not connect to the diffuser over Bluetooth. Turn it on, close Mi Home, and temporarily disable Bluetooth on your phone. Then retry.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth address is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth advertisement does not match an exact registered SO candidate model.
abort.credential_storage_failed: Could not save the device token. Existing settings were not removed.
abort.legacy_entry_exists: This diffuser still has a config entry under the old so_s5 domain. Back up HA and remove the old config entry through Home Assistant before setting up the new domain. Do not delete its token. See docs/MIGRATION.md.

progress.oauth: {link_left}Open Xiaomi sign-in{link_right}. After login, if `{default_host}` cannot be opened, **in the browser address bar** replace only that address with your HA server address (for example `{example_host}`). Keep the rest of the URL unchanged, then press Enter. Never share this link.

options.existing: Use a previously saved S5 token
